title: Tumor-myeloid crosstalk drives therapy resistance in localized bladder cancer.
snippet: Neoadjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy results in pathologic complete response for only a minority of patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC), and mechanisms of resistance and chemotherapy-induced remodeling of the tumor microenvironment remain incompletely understood.
